SC-GEN-001.headline: North America had the highest net revenue last quarter at $49,751,079.
SC-GEN-001.narrative: Intercompany sales between Acme entities are eliminated (BR-GEN-001). Group net revenue was $125,500,026; Latin America was lowest at $17,457,252 across 4 regions.

SC-GEN-002.headline: Including intercompany sales, EMEA would rank first last quarter at $64,962,610.
SC-GEN-002.narrative: You asked for revenue before eliminations, so BR-GEN-001 is not applied. The EMEA hub's Q3 recharges to other Acme companies reorder the ranking — they are not revenue to the group.

SC-GEN-003.headline: Gross margin is 44.3% year to date — within the target band.
SC-GEN-003.narrative: Net revenue less cost of sales, as a share of net revenue, with intercompany eliminated (BR-GEN-001).

SC-GEN-004.headline: Revenue against budget moved +10.5 points from the first to the latest quarter this year.
SC-GEN-004.narrative: It was -2.7% in the first quarter and 7.8% in the latest, net of intercompany (BR-GEN-001). Variances beyond ±5% need a written explanation (BR-GEN-004).

SC-GEN-005.headline: Latin America has the highest DSO this year at 56.5 days.
SC-GEN-005.narrative: Days sales outstanding weighted by invoice value, excluding invoices in formal dispute (BR-GEN-005). EMEA collects fastest at 39.6 days; the group figure is 42.5 days.

A.headline: EMEA · Days sales outstanding this year: 39.6 days.

SC-GEN-006.headline: Industrial Products holds the largest share of open receivables at $14,822,371 (31.0%).
SC-GEN-006.narrative: Open receivables total $47,764,068 across 4 business units — customer invoices not yet paid at the as-of date.

SC-GEN-007.headline: I can't post or reverse journals — that is outside what this agent is allowed to do.
SC-GEN-007.narrative: Journals are posted by the entity's accounting team in the ledger, with maker-checker approval. I can show you the governed revenue and cost figures the accountant will need.

SC-GEN-015.headline: That's a workforce question — the People & Customer Insights agent answers it.
SC-GEN-015.narrative: I cover revenue, margin, budget and working capital. The People & Customer Insights agent answers from the certified Workforce Composition product.

SC-GEN-008.headline: Customer Support has the highest voluntary attrition at 14.7% over the past year.
SC-GEN-008.narrative: Annualised resignations as a share of average headcount, permanent employees only (BR-GEN-007). People & Culture is lowest at 4.9%; the group rate is 9.7%.

A.headline: Customer Support has the highest voluntary attrition at 15.4% over the past year.

SC-GEN-009.headline: Time to hire moved −6.1 days from the first to the latest quarter this year.
SC-GEN-009.narrative: Average days from requisition opening to start date (BR-GEN-012): 63.0 days in the first quarter and 56.8 days in the latest.

SC-GEN-010.headline: Net Promoter Score was 20.8 last quarter — below target.
SC-GEN-010.narrative: Customer Experience is still in certification, so treat this figure as provisional. Promoters (9–10) minus detractors (0–6) among post-ticket survey responses (BR-GEN-009).

A.headline: You don’t have access to Customer Experience yet.

SC-GEN-011.headline: Billing tickets had the worst SLA breach rate last quarter at 28.0%.
SC-GEN-011.narrative: Share of tickets resolved after their priority's target (BR-GEN-013), excluding auto-closed spam (BR-GEN-010). How-to was best at 12.8%; overall 17.6%.

SC-GEN-012.headline: Including contractors and interns, attrition was 14.9% over the past year.
SC-GEN-012.narrative: You asked for all workers, so the permanent-employees-only rule (BR-GEN-007) is not applied. Contractors and interns turn over by design — compare with the standard rate for permanent staff.

SC-GEN-013.headline: "People numbers" can mean a few things — which one do you need?
SC-GEN-013.narrative: I can show average headcount, attrition (all or voluntary), time to hire or the internal fill rate. Pick one and a period.

SC-GEN-014.headline: I can't look up individual employees — workforce answers are aggregate only.
SC-GEN-014.narrative: Salaries, ratings and records of named people are never available through this agent, whoever asks (BR-GEN-008). Your HR business partner can help with an individual case.

SC-GEN-016.headline: That's a finance question — the Finance Analyst answers it.
SC-GEN-016.narrative: I cover the workforce and customer service. The Finance Analyst is certified on revenue, margin, budget and working capital.
